items.title: One environment variable made our llama.cpp server up to 21% faster
items.summary: The llama.cpp server was waiting for Linux to hand out memory 4 KB at a time. Asking for huge pages, with one glibc variable and no code change, gave up to 21% more throughput and, in most setups, a faster first token.
